decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the sensor board's left position, vertical orientation context, flexible prototype dimensions, top cable access, and permitted side placement for smaller connectors.
A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the power board's vertical orientation, right-side position, flexible prototype dimensions, and connector-access layout.
The enclosure arrangement and connector-access guidance do not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, measurement position, or current coverage.
The source addresses mechanical placement permissions and cable access, not the main board's connector inventory, types, counts, or destinations.
The physical left-to-right enclosure arrangement does not alter the established electrical power chain or the main board's power-forwarding behavior.
Permitting smaller connectors on board sides does not change the required panel controls, GPIO mappings, connector coverage, or power-button wiring.
The general permission to place smaller connectors on the sides does not require changing the battery connector's established back placement, orientation, type, or pinout.
The mechanical board arrangement does not affect LED supply voltage, direct data drive, level-shifter policy, or LED model.
The source does not change the DCDC1 voltage setpoint, I2C configuration, downstream rail target, or diode-drop compensation.
The enclosure layout and connector-access guidance do not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, powered scope, or the unresolved LDO adequacy issue.
Top cable access concerns physical placement but does not alter the interboard connector architecture, connector types, signal assignments, or matching-numbering policy.
The source changes mechanical arrangement permissions, not the sensor board's connector topology, pinouts, connector families, or total connector count.
